program: Pediatric clinical dentistry, school sealants and oral-health outreach

what: Kids In Need of Dentistry provides dental care for children from low-income families in Colorado.
Its Commerce City clinic offers preventive, restorative and specialized care, while Chopper Topper brings screening and preventive services to Denver-area schools.
Community outreach helps families access oral-health support.
strengths: Three original IRS filings establish whole-recipient expenses.
Original 2023 report identifies 9,337 sealants and separates clinic and outreach activity.
Randomized evidence supports permanent-molar sealants; an external US school-program model supplies a transparent health bridge.
reservations: DALY-to-QALY conversion, four-molar-equivalent scaling, residence share and benefit transport are analyst assumptions.
Only the sealant pathway is counted; total recipient benefits remain incompletely modeled.
Donor HOLD: no priced marginal gift, current capacity or verified checkout.

sections.what: KIND provides pediatric clinical dentistry in Commerce City and school prevention through Chopper Topper. Its current clinical page lists prevention, restorative and specialized care, including general anesthesia, and accepts Medicaid, Delta Dental and CHP+. Its school page describes Denver-area schools with at least half their students eligible for subsidized lunch.
sections.monitoring: The original 2023 report PDF page 3, printed pages 4–5, reports 5,302 school children, 9,337 preventive sealants, 705 clinic patients and 3,449 outreach recipients. The original 2023 990 reports 6,007 dental-service children, consistent with school plus clinic counts, but cross-program deduplication is unverified. The 2024 filing reports 7,213 dental-service children and 5,735 kit recipients without a sealant count. Do not treat all overall reach as treated children or 2023 output as current 2026 output.
sections.qualitative: Cochrane randomized evidence supports permanent-molar sealants but primary-tooth evidence is uncertain. Griffin et al. model 1.59 DALYs averted per 1,000 children receiving four first-molar sealants over four years. Dividing KIND's sealants by four creates modeled equivalents, not unique children. Transport, substitution, local residence and DALY-to-QALY conversion remain judgmental. No clinic, anxiety, kit, education or caregiver benefits are added. Excluded benefits are unquantified rather than proven zero; this is not a lower bound.
sections.cost: Use 2023 whole-recipient Form 990 expenses of $1,536,905 to match the 2023 output. This includes $1,124,202 program, $237,562 management and $175,141 fundraising. Original 2024 expense is $1,879,713 and 2022 gross resource expense is $1,559,737: Part IX $1,419,662 plus $140,075 of Part VIII line 8b direct event costs. In 2023 and 2024, relevant Part VIII netted direct-expense lines are blank; no addback is needed. The comparable three-year gross-resource mean is $1,658,785. No revenue, insurance reimbursement or external societal savings are subtracted, and no unverified in-kind gross-up is added. Unrecorded opportunity costs are outside this accounting perspective. Annual-report 2023 expense $1,531,508 differs from the IRS total; use the latter and preserve the discrepancy.
sections.funding: The official home page links a general Classy donation route redirected to give.kindsmiles.org. Redirect observed; checkout fields and receipt identity unreadable, no transaction submitted. A historical 2023–24 appeal mentioned 30 waiting schools but does not prove current funding room. Local service location is established; beneficiary residence is not. The local-share prior excludes Boulder, Greeley and Colorado Springs under the edition boundary. Average recipient spending cannot price a marginal gift without current capacity, demand, reimbursement and replacement-funding evidence.

model.costScope: Whole-recipient 2023 accounting expense; sealant benefits only; no marginal-gift claim.
model.geographicAttribution: L=.90 is a judgmental Denver-MSA residence share, not measured from program location.
model.formula: Q_all=(S/4)*D*T*A*K; Q_MSA=Q_all*L-H; price10=10*C/Q_MSA for positive Q_MSA
model.counterfactual: Alternative dental providers and usual preventive care can replace some KIND benefit; A captures remaining incremental benefit, not marginal donor funding response.
model.attribution: Externally modeled sealant health benefits are transported to KIND using T. K is an unvalidated DALY-to-QALY conversion. Other program benefits are unquantified. Linear scaling from sealants to four-molar child-equivalents is unvalidated: the original model calculates child-level toothache risk, so identical benefit per tooth is a further approximation covered by T, not an empirically validated conversion.
model.uncertainty: Illustrative scenarios only, not confidence bounds. Zero and net-harm cases have no finite benefit price.
model.nativeOutcomes: 9,337 preventive sealants in 2023; 2,334.25 four-molar equivalents are a modeling construct, not unique children.

inputs.name: C
inputs.rationale: 2023 whole-recipient accounting cost matches output year.

inputs.name: S
inputs.rationale: 2023 original report sealant count; tooth types and reapplications unverified.

inputs.name: D
inputs.rationale: External four-year model with 3% health discounting, not KIND measured impact; transport handled separately.

inputs.name: T
inputs.rationale: Applicability, tooth-type mix, retention and quality relative to external model. Also includes the unvalidated linear four-molar-equivalent scaling of child-level modeled pain risk.

inputs.name: A
inputs.rationale: Incremental benefit after substitute care and duplication.

inputs.name: L
inputs.rationale: Local residence not measured; delivery evidence only.

inputs.name: K
inputs.rationale: Unvalidated conversion assumption; DALYs are not observed QALYs.

inputs.name: H
inputs.rationale: Unknown harm set zero centrally; adverse stress case explicit.

scenarios.label: Illustrative annual-average
scenarios.assumptions: T=.75,A=.75,L=.90,K=1,H=0; all judgments; unvalidated DALY-to-QALY bridge. This is an illustrative reference case, not an expected-value or donor-ranking central estimate.

scenarios.label: Pessimistic positive
scenarios.assumptions: T=.5,A=.25,L=.75,K=.5,H=0; selected illustration, not lower bound.

scenarios.label: Optimistic positive
scenarios.assumptions: T=1,A=1,L=1,K=1.5,H=0; selected illustration, not upper bound.

scenarios.label: Net-harm stress test
scenarios.assumptions: T=0,A=0,L=.9,K=1,H=.1; assumed harm entirely local, not observed KIND harm.

sensitivity: Halving L or A doubles positive price.
No additional efficacy or four-year multiplier: already embedded in D.
2024 expense with historical activity is only a cost stress test, not a matched current estimate.
Clinic and other benefits remain unquantified; these are not total-benefit confidence bounds.
